question: Can tapping a creature to reduce a harmonize cost reduce the colored mana in that cost?

expected.shortAnswer: No: tapping a creature does not reduce colored mana components of harmonize costs.
expected.answer: Tapping a creature won’t reduce colored mana components of harmonize costs.
